description: This file contains a function 'Gem5ImageUnpacker' that handles unpacking and preparing boot images and related files for the Gem5 VM manager within the Cuttlefish project. It includes logic for copying kernel and bootloader files, creating directory structures, and handling specific boot image extraction tasks.
